acceptanceCriteria: CAL-V0-073 and CAL-V0-106 are defined inside `## Requirements` of a domain spec, with stable IDs or a recorded alias
Their RDG-V0-021 baseline rows are deleted
OCM accepts every touched section; docgates pass
body: Batch 1021c (2026-10-21): the spec-ocm-citations lane moved the CAL-V0-073 and CAL-V0-106 definitions into the `## Requirements` section of the leases spec. With main's new CAL-V0-320 and 350..353, that made 258 obligations, and OCM refused the whole section with too-many-obligations. The batch reverted those two moves and restored their RDG-V0-021 baseline rows. The owner decided on 2026-10-17 to re-home new requirements to domain specs (PSR/ATR) rather than raise the bound.

title: Re-home CAL-V0-073 and CAL-V0-106 into a domain spec: the leases spec's Requirements section is at the 256-obligation OCM bound
